pages.title: Roller Coasters
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Place **Track Anchorpoints**, then link two with **Coaster Track** for a smooth curve.
- Tracks cannot split or cross over themselves.
- Carts are physics objects like airships, not Create trains.
- A chain lift runs on Create rotation.

Simulated Coasters lets you lay free-form coaster track with curves, banks and chain lifts, and ride it in carts. Carts are [#](7A3C9A)[physics objects](entry://glossary/sub_level)[#](), the same system airships use, not Create trains.

pages.title: Track and anchorpoints
pages.text:
Place Track Anchorpoints, then link two with Coaster Track to make a smooth curve.

- A [#](2E5AAC)[wrench](entry://create_basics/tools_wrench)[#]() reshapes it, and banking and height can be tuned.
- **Dye** tints the rails and an **axe** removes it.
- Tracks **cannot split** or cross over themselves.

pages.title: Coaster Track
pages.text: Click one anchorpoint, then another. Smoothing is automatic; hold left alt while placing to turn it off.

pages.title: Track Anchorpoint
pages.text: The posts that tracks hang between. Each can take two connections.

pages.title: Chain lifts
pages.text: Use a Chain to pick a start and an end on connected track to add a chain lift. The shaft at the start takes Create [#](2E5AAC)[rotation](entry://create_basics/rotation)[#]() to drive it. Sneak-use a wrench anywhere on the span to remove it.

pages.title: Coaster Cart
pages.text: Place on track. Use the cart item on a placed cart, then place another to couple them. Shears cut links and a wrench changes length. Build on the carts.

pages.title: Rivet
pages.text: Lets a block sit at any angle or offset. Tap the rotate key for 15 degree steps, hold for free rotation.

pages.title: Red Balloon
pages.text: Lifts a ship slightly off the ground and keeps it upright. Popping one pops its neighbours, dropping the ship.

pages.title: Seats and styles
pages.text: Create: Coaster Seats adds Lapbar and Restrictor seats in all 16 colours. A Restrictor locks the rider in by [#](7A3C9A)[Redstone Link frequency](entry://glossary/redstone_frequency)[#]() or a redstone signal. Coasters Simulated: Track Styles adds a Coaster Style Tool and an Anchor Style Tool for extra looks.

pages.title: Restrictor Seat
pages.text: Set the lock mode with a wrench: link only, link and redstone, or redstone only.

pages.title: Coaster Style Tool
pages.text: Changes the look of existing coaster track.
